statement:
∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 1 f → KdVPlan.MemH 1 g →
 KdVPlan.HB 1 (KdVPlan.mul f g) (3 * (1 + KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I * (k : ℂ))⁻¹)) * KdVPlan.hn 1 f * KdVPlan.hn 1 g)
proof:
intro f g hf hg
let E := 1 + KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I * (k : ℂ))⁻¹)
have hE : 0 ≤ E := by dsimp [E, KdVPlan.hn]; positivity
have lf := yui_aux_0014 T gamma R h_T013 f hf
have lg := yui_aux_0014 T gamma R h_T013 g hg
have Hf := (yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_T013).1 f hf
have Hg := (yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_T013).1 g hg
have H₀ := yui_aux_0007 T gamma R h_T013 f g lf.1 Hg.1.1
have H₁ := yui_aux_0007 T gamma R h_T013 g (KdVPlan.dx f) lg.1 Hf.2.1
have H₂ := yui_aux_0007 T gamma R h_T013 f (KdVPlan.dx g) lf.1 Hg.2.1
have b₀ : KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.mul f g) ≤ E * KdVPlan.hn 1 f * KdVPlan.hn 1 g := by
 apply H₀.2.trans
 exact mul_le_mul lf.2 Hg.1.2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hE (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
have b₁ : KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.mul g (KdVPlan.dx f)) ≤ E * KdVPlan.hn 1 f * KdVPlan.hn 1 g := by
 apply H₁.2.trans
 calc
  (∑' k, ‖g k‖) * KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.dx f) ≤ (E * KdVPlan.hn 1 g) * KdVPlan.hn 1 f :=
   mul_le_mul lg.2 Hf.2.2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hE (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
  _ = E * KdVPlan.hn 1 f * KdVPlan.hn 1 g := by ring
have b₂ : KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.mul f (KdVPlan.dx g)) ≤ E * KdVPlan.hn 1 f * KdVPlan.hn 1 g := by
 apply H₂.2.trans
 exact mul_le_mul lf.2 Hg.2.2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hE (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
have hd : KdVPlan.dx (KdVPlan.mul f g) = KdVPlan.mul g (KdVPlan.dx f) + KdVPlan.mul f (KdVPlan.dx g) := by
 rw [(yui_aux_0015 T gamma R h_T013).2 f g hf hg, (yui_aux_0015 T gamma R h_T013).1 (KdVPlan.dx f) g]
have Hsum := yui_aux_0001 T gamma R h_T013 0 _ _ H₁.1 H₂.1
have H := (yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_T013).2 (KdVPlan.mul f g) H₀.1 (hd ▸ Hsum.1)
refine ⟨H.1, H.2.trans ?_⟩
have hb : KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.dx (KdVPlan.mul f g)) ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.mul g (KdVPlan.dx f)) + KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.mul f (KdVPlan.dx g)) := by rw [hd]; exact Hsum.2.1
change KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.mul f g) + KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.dx (KdVPlan.mul f g)) ≤ 3 * E * KdVPlan.hn 1 f * KdVPlan.hn 1 g
nlinarith
